name: Adjust HSL
description: Adjust the hue, saturation and luminosity of the image.

parameters.name: Hue
parameters.desc: Amount of hue rotation to apply, from 0 to 100.

parameters.name: Saturation
parameters.desc: Saturation factor, from 0 to 100 or beyond.

parameters.name: Luminosity
parameters.desc: Amount to offset luminosity, from 0 to 200.
